parameters.query:
// ======================================================================
// Customer Info - Customer / Subscription Selector
// ======================================================================

resources
| where type =~ "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces"
| summarize by subscriptionId

| join kind=leftouter
(
    ManagedServicesResources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.managedservices/registrationassignments"
    | extend Directory = coalesce(
        tostring(properties.registrationDefinition.properties.manageeTenantName),
        tostring(properties.manageeTenantName)
    )
    | extend Directory = trim(@"[^\w\s\.-]+", Directory)
    | where isnotempty(Directory)
    | summarize Directory = any(Directory) by subscriptionId
)
on subscriptionId

| extend SubscriptionResourceId = strcat("/subscriptions/", subscriptionId)
| extend selected = subscriptionId =~ "{DefaultSubscription_Internal}"
| extend group = iff(isnotempty(Directory), Directory, "Local / Other")
| project SubscriptionResourceId, selected, group
| distinct SubscriptionResourceId, selected, group
| order by group asc, SubscriptionResourceId asc

# Change Log

| Date | Changes |
|---|---|
| **30 September 2026** | Added a **Summary** tab with tiles showing AI service, AI agent and deep-search provider/product catalogue coverage. |
|  | Added explanatory guidance for AI Services, AI Agents and Tools, and AI Deep Search. |
|  | Updated the AI services and AI agent `externaldata` sources to the Microsoft Azure Sentinel public catalogues. |
|  | Retained the consolidated deep-search source in its current location pending its move to the Microsoft Azure Sentinel catalogue. |
| **26 September 2026** | Added a dedicated **🌱 Sanctioned AI Agents** selector for local agents, cloud agents, local model hosts and agentic tools. |
|  | Added the separate **AIAgentGovernance** Sentinel watchlist and `ai_agent_governance_watchlist.csv` upload file. |
|  | Added automatic selection of agent watchlist rows marked `Sanctioned=TRUE`. |
|  | Added Local and Cloud **AI Agent Governance at a Glance** summaries. |
|  | Added Local and Cloud **Sanctioned Agents Not Observed** reports. |
|  | Added optional-table handling for Cloud agent telemetry. |
|  | Normalised agent keys and consolidated results to one row per tool or agent. |
|  | Clarified the separation between public catalogues, governance watchlists and risk classification. |
| **22 September 2026** | Refined AI governance mapping around stable **PolicyKey** identifiers. |
|  | Added optional **AIGovernance** watchlist support for customer-specific AI products. |
|  | Added **AI Usage & Adoption** and **AI Usage by User** reports. |
|  | Clarified the separation between governance status and risk classification. |
|  | Expanded workbook guidance for catalogue configuration, telemetry interpretation and inferred usage measures. |
| **V1.0** | Added configurable sanctioned AI service selection, governance classification, compliance review, AI product summaries, new-user analysis, multi-product usage and AI agent/tool detection. |

# 🤖 AI Governance

This workbook provides a high-level view of AI usage and agent activity observed through Microsoft Defender telemetry. It helps organisations understand which AI services, products and agents are being used and whether that activity aligns with approved policy.

## 📊 Summary

The **Summary** tab shows the breadth of the workbook's detection capability.

The tiles count providers and products in the catalogues used by the workbook across:

- AI services and products
- AI agents, tools and local model hosts
- Additional products identified by AI Deep Search

These figures represent catalogue coverage, not observed usage during the selected time range.

## 🛡️ AI Services

The AI services reports use the public AI services catalogue to identify recognised providers and products across web services, APIs, developer tools and desktop clients.

The reports use `DeviceNetworkEvents` to identify network activity and `DeviceProcessEvents` to identify local AI applications and tools.

An optional Sentinel watchlist with alias `AIGovernance` can add customer-specific AI products, override matching public catalogue entries and define sanctioned-policy defaults. Local catalogue entries are shown with `[Local]`.

If a service or product is not recognised, add it to the local `AIGovernance` Watchlist.

## 🤖 AI Agents and Tools

The AI agent reports use the agent and tool catalogue to identify local agents, cloud agents, local model hosts and agentic tooling.

The local agent report searches `DeviceProcessEvents`. Cloud agent detection uses available audit and identity telemetry, including `OfficeActivity`, `AuditLogs` and service-principal sign-in data where available.

An optional local governance file can be uploaded to Sentinel as the `AIAgentGovernance` Watchlist. Rows marked `Sanctioned=TRUE` are selected automatically.

Agent activity is classified as:

- 🟢 **Sanctioned** — activity associated with a selected approved agent or tool.
- 🔴 **Unsanctioned** — recognised agent or tool activity not included in the selected policy.
- ⚪ **Sanctioned not observed** — a selected sanctioned agent with no matching evidence during the selected time range.

If an agent or tool is not recognised, add it to the local `AIAgentGovernance` Watchlist.

## 🔎 AI Deep Search

AI Deep Search uses a broader consolidated AI and agent watchlist to identify products not already covered by the standard public or local sources.

The device report searches `DeviceNetworkEvents` and `DeviceProcessEvents`. The agent report searches available agent and AI service telemetry.

`AlreadyCovered = false` highlights additional watchlist items outside the existing reports. These results are intended for enrichment and investigation.

The consolidated deep-search source is currently hosted in its existing location and is expected to move to the Microsoft Azure Sentinel catalogue in the same `AIGovernance` folder. If you need to cover additional items in the standard reports, add them to your local Watchlists.

## 📈 Reports

**AI Compliance & Governance Review** provides the main view of sanctioned and unsanctioned AI service activity, including browser, API/developer, non-browser network and desktop-client evidence.

**AI Usage & Adoption** summarises active days, observed sessions, users, devices and activity volume across the selected time range.

**AI Usage by User** provides per-user activity patterns, product usage, observed sessions and supporting telemetry.

**Local and Cloud AI Agent Governance at a Glance** summarise sanctioned agents observed, unsanctioned agents observed and selected sanctioned agents with no evidence.

**Local and Cloud Sanctioned Agents Not Observed** list selected sanctioned agents for which no evidence was found during the selected time range.

**AI Deep Search** identifies additional providers, products and agents for investigation and possible inclusion in local governance Watchlists.

## 🛡️ Interpreting the Results

Network, process, audit and identity telemetry demonstrates observed communication, execution or service activity. It does not establish user intent, the content submitted to an AI service or agent, or the amount of time a user actively spent using it.

Risk and recommended action values come from the detection catalogues and are separate from sanctioned or unsanctioned governance status.

## 🛡️ Microsoft Defender Data Requirements

The workbook primarily uses:

- `DeviceNetworkEvents` — observed connections to recognised AI services.
- `DeviceProcessEvents` — execution of recognised AI clients, agents, model hosts and related processes.
- `OfficeActivity` — Microsoft 365 and Purview audit activity.
- `AuditLogs` — Microsoft Entra audit activity.
- `AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs` — Microsoft Entra service-principal sign-in activity.
- The optional `AIGovernance` and `AIAgentGovernance` Watchlists — customer-specific catalogue entries and sanctioned-policy defaults.

Cloud sources are queried opportunistically; unavailable tables are ignored. Results depend on Microsoft Defender licensing, endpoint onboarding, available telemetry and retention.

> **Tip:** Where the required Defender telemetry is not available through Microsoft Sentinel, try the workbook from **Microsoft Defender → Microsoft Sentinel → Workbooks**.

    Product:string,
    Domain:string,
    Category:string,

    ProcessPublisher:string

]
with (
    format="csv",
    ignoreFirstRecord=true
)
| extend Sanctioned=false, CatalogueSource="Public", SourcePriority=1
| extend PolicyKey=trim(@"^-+|-+$", replace_regex(tolower(strcat(Provider,"-",Product)), @"[^a-z0-9]+", "-"))
| extend MatchKey=case(
    isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
    isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
    strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
);

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key), CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist", SourcePriority=2
    | extend MatchKey=case(
        isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
        isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );

let AIData =
    union PublicAIData, LocalAIData
    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)
    | summarize arg_max(SourcePriority, *) by MatchKey
    | project Provider,Product,Domain,Category,Sanctioned,RiskType,SourceURL,ProcessName,ProcessProductName,ProcessPublisher,PolicyKey,CatalogueSource;

AIData
| extend DisplayPriority=iff(CatalogueSource=="Local Watchlist",10,0)+iff(isnotempty(Domain),1,0)
| summarize
    arg_max(DisplayPriority,Provider,Product,Domain),
    HasLocal=countif(CatalogueSource=="Local Watchlist")>0,
    IsSelected=countif(CatalogueSource=="Local Watchlist" and Sanctioned==true)>0
  by PolicyKey
| extend Label=strcat(Provider," - ",Product,iff(isnotempty(Domain),strcat(" (",Domain,")")," (process / local)"),iff(HasLocal," [Local]",""))
| project Value=PolicyKey, Label, selected=IsSelected
| order by Label asc

content.query:
// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED AI PRODUCTS OBSERVED
//
// Rolls observed activity up by PolicyKey so governance counts
// align with the Sanctioned AI Coverage panel.
//
// Multiple evidence rows for the same governed product, such as
// ChatGPT web + ChatGPT desktop, are shown as one logical
// sanctioned product.
// ============================================================


// ============================================================
// PUBLIC AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let PublicAIData =
    externaldata(
        Provider:string,
        Product:string,
        Domain:string,
        Category:string,
        Sanctioned:bool,
        RiskType:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        ProcessName:string,
        ProcessProductName:string,
        ProcessPublisher:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_domains.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )
    | extend
        Sanctioned = false,
        CatalogueSource = "Public",
        SourcePriority = 1
    | extend PolicyKey =
        trim(
            @"^-+|-+$",
            replace_regex(
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        Provider,
                        "-",
                        Product
                    )
                ),
                @"[^a-z0-9]+",
                "-"
            )
        )
    | extend MatchKey =
        case(
            isnotempty(Domain),
                strcat(
                    "domain:",
                    tolower(
                        trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)
                    )
                ),

            isnotempty(ProcessName),
                strcat(
                    "process:",
                    tolower(
                        trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", ProcessName)
                    )
                ),

            strcat(
                "product:",
                tolower(
                    trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Provider)
                ),
                "|",
                tolower(
                    trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Product)
                )
            )
        );


// ============================================================
// OPTIONAL LOCAL WATCHLIST
// ============================================================

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key), CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist", SourcePriority=2
    | extend MatchKey=case(
        isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
        isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );


// ============================================================
// EFFECTIVE AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIData =
    union
        PublicAIData,
        LocalAIData

    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)

    | summarize
        arg_max(
            SourcePriority,
            *
        )
      by MatchKey

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        ProcessName,
        ProcessProductName,
        ProcessPublisher,
        PolicyKey,
        CatalogueSource;


// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED POLICY KEYS
// ============================================================

let SanctionedPolicies =
    dynamic([{Sanctioned}]);


// ============================================================
// KNOWN AI DOMAINS
// ============================================================

let AIDomains =
    toscalar(
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | summarize make_set(Domain, 1000)
    );


// ============================================================
// NETWORK ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let NetworkActivity =
    DeviceNetworkEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)

    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)

    | where has_any_index(tolower(RemoteUrl), AIDomains) >= 0

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn), InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        RemoteUrl,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName

    | extend RemoteUrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | extend UrlNoQuery = replace_regex(RemoteUrlLower, @"[?#].*$", "")
    | extend UrlNoScheme = replace_regex(UrlNoQuery, @"^https?://", "")
    | extend UrlMatchKeys = pack_array(
        strcat("host:", tostring(split(UrlNoScheme, "/")[0])),
        strcat("path:", UrlNoScheme)
    )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = UrlMatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", "")),
        User = tostring(column_ifexists("User", "")),
        DeviceId = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceId", "")),
        DeviceName = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
        RemoteUrl = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        Process = tostring(column_ifexists("Process", "")),
        MatchKey
    | distinct Timestamp, User, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, Process, MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)), @"^https?://", "")
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(DomainKey, @"/+$", "")
        | extend DomainMatchKey = iff(DomainKey contains "/", strcat("path:", DomainKey), strcat("host:", DomainKey))
        | project DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
        | distinct DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
    ) on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainMatchKey

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | where IsSanctioned

    | project
        Timestamp,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        User,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        AccessType = "Network";


// ============================================================
// PROCESS CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIProcesses =
    AIData

    | where isnotempty(ProcessName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessProductName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessPublisher)
        or PolicyKey in (
            "openai-chatgpt",
            "anthropic-claude",
            "anthropic-claude-code"
        )

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,

        CatalogueProcessName =
            ProcessName,

        CatalogueProductName =
            ProcessProductName,

        CataloguePublisher =
            ProcessPublisher;


// ============================================================
// DESKTOP ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let DesktopActivity =
    DeviceProcessEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | where isnotempty(AccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(AccountName)

    | extend
        ProcessNameLower =
            tolower(FileName),

        ProductNameLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoProductName
            ),

        PublisherLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
            )

    | extend

        PathMatchKey = case(
            FolderPath contains "ChatGPT.app", "path:openai-chatgpt",
            FolderPath contains "Claude.app", "path:anthropic-claude",
            FolderPath contains "ClaudeCode.app", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            FolderPath contains "@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            ""
        )

    | extend

        MatchKeys = pack_array(
            iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
            PathMatchKey
        )

    | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        HasProductName = isnotempty(ProductNameLower),
        HasPublisher = isnotempty(PublisherLower),
        MatchKey
    | summarize by Timestamp, User, AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, ProcessNameLower, ProductNameLower, PublisherLower, HasProductName, HasPublisher, MatchKey

    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIProcesses
        | extend
            ProcessNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProcessName
                ),

            CatalogueProductNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProductName
                ),

            CataloguePublisherLower =
                tolower(
                    CataloguePublisher
                )

        | extend

            CataloguePathKey = case(
                PolicyKey == "openai-chatgpt", "path:openai-chatgpt",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude", "path:anthropic-claude",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                ""
            )

        | extend

            MatchKeys = pack_array(
                iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
                CataloguePathKey
            )

        | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

        | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

        | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    ) on MatchKey

    | where
        isempty(CatalogueProductName)
        or ProductNameLower == CatalogueProductNameLower
        or not(HasProductName)

    | where
        isempty(CataloguePublisher)
        or PublisherLower has CataloguePublisherLower
        or not(HasPublisher)

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | where IsSanctioned

    | project
        Timestamp,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        AccessType = "Desktop Client";


// ============================================================
// COMBINE ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let CombinedActivity =
    union
        NetworkActivity,
        DesktopActivity;


// ============================================================
// ROLL UP TO GOVERNANCE PRODUCT
//
// PolicyKey is the logical sanctioned product identity.
// ============================================================

CombinedActivity

| summarize
    Users =
        dcount(User),

    Devices =
        dcount(DeviceId),

    Activity =
        count(),

    ProductNames =
        make_set(
            Product,
            20
        ),

    Domains =
        make_set_if(
            Domain,
            isnotempty(Domain),
            20
        ),

    AccessTypes =
        make_set(
            AccessType,
            10
        ),

    UserList =
        make_set(
            User,
            20
        ),

    DeviceList =
        make_set(
            DeviceName,
            20
        ),

    FirstSeen =
        min(Timestamp),

    LastSeen =
        max(Timestamp)

  by
    PolicyKey,
    Provider


// ============================================================
// FRIENDLY DISPLAY
// ============================================================

| extend ProductList =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            ProductNames
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ProductTitle =
    strcat(
        Provider,
        " - ",
        ProductList
    )

| extend AccessTypeList =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            AccessTypes
        ),
        ", "

//
// Shows customer-sanctioned AI products that were NOT observed
// during the selected Workbook TimeRange.

// Uses PolicyKey as the logical governance identity so multiple
// evidence rows for the same product do not inflate counts.
// ============================================================


// ============================================================
// PUBLIC AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let PublicAIData =
    externaldata(
        Provider:string,
        Product:string,
        Domain:string,
        Category:string,
        Sanctioned:bool,
        RiskType:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        ProcessName:string,
        ProcessProductName:string,
        ProcessPublisher:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_domains.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )
    | extend
        Sanctioned = false,
        CatalogueSource = "Public",
        SourcePriority = 1
    | extend PolicyKey =
        trim(
            @"^-+|-+$",
            replace_regex(
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        Provider,
                        "-",
                        Product
                    )
                ),
                @"[^a-z0-9]+",
                "-"
            )
        )
    | extend MatchKey =
        case(
            isnotempty(Domain),
                strcat(
                    "domain:",
                    tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain))
                ),

            isnotempty(ProcessName),
                strcat(
                    "process:",
                    tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", ProcessName))
                ),

            strcat(
                "product:",
                tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Provider)),
                "|",
                tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Product))
            )
        );


// ============================================================
// OPTIONAL LOCAL WATCHLIST
// ============================================================

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key), CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist", SourcePriority=2

        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );


// ============================================================
// EFFECTIVE AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIData =
    union
        PublicAIData,
        LocalAIData

    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)

    | summarize
        arg_max(
            SourcePriority,
            *
        )
      by MatchKey

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        ProcessName,
        ProcessProductName,
        ProcessPublisher,
        PolicyKey,
        CatalogueSource;


// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED POLICY KEYS
// ============================================================

let SanctionedPolicies =
    dynamic([{Sanctioned}]);


// ============================================================
// CONFIGURED SANCTIONED INVENTORY
//
// One logical row per PolicyKey.
// ============================================================

let SanctionedInventory =
    AIData

    | where
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0

    | where set_has_element(
        SanctionedPolicies,
        PolicyKey
    )

    | summarize
        Provider =
            take_any(Provider),

        ProductNames =
            make_set(
                Product,
                20
            ),

        Domains =
            make_set_if(
                Domain,
                isnotempty(Domain),
                20
            ),

        Processes =
            make_set_if(
                ProcessName,
                isnotempty(ProcessName),
                20
            ),

        CatalogueSources =
            make_set(
                CatalogueSource,
                10
            )

      by PolicyKey;


// ============================================================
// KNOWN AI DOMAINS
// ============================================================

let AIDomains =
    toscalar(
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | summarize make_set(Domain, 1000)
    );


// ============================================================
// NETWORK OBSERVATIONS
// ============================================================

let NetworkObserved =
    DeviceNetworkEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)

    | where has_any_index(tolower(RemoteUrl), AIDomains) >= 0

    | project RemoteUrl

    | extend RemoteUrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | extend UrlNoQuery = replace_regex(RemoteUrlLower, @"[?#].*$", "")
    | extend UrlNoScheme = replace_regex(UrlNoQuery, @"^https?://", "")
    | extend UrlMatchKeys = pack_array(
        strcat("host:", tostring(split(UrlNoScheme, "/")[0])),
        strcat("path:", UrlNoScheme)
    )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = UrlMatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", "")),
        User = tostring(column_ifexists("User", "")),
        DeviceId = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceId", "")),
        DeviceName = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
        RemoteUrl = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        Process = tostring(column_ifexists("Process", "")),
        MatchKey
    | distinct Timestamp, User, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, Process, MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)), @"^https?://", "")
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(DomainKey, @"/+$", "")
        | extend DomainMatchKey = iff(DomainKey contains "/", strcat("path:", DomainKey), strcat("host:", DomainKey))
        | project DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
        | distinct DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
    ) on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainMatchKey

    | where set_has_element(
        SanctionedPolicies,
        PolicyKey
    )

    | project PolicyKey;


// ============================================================
// DESKTOP / PROCESS CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIProcesses =
    AIData

    | where isnotempty(ProcessName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessProductName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessPublisher)
        or PolicyKey in (
            "openai-chatgpt",
            "anthropic-claude",
            "anthropic-claude-code"
        )

    | project
        PolicyKey,

        CatalogueProcessName =
            ProcessName,

        CatalogueProductName =
            ProcessProductName,

        CataloguePublisher =
            ProcessPublisher;


// ============================================================
// DESKTOP / PROCESS OBSERVATIONS
// ============================================================

let DesktopObserved =
    DeviceProcessEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | extend
        ProcessNameLower =
            tolower(FileName),

        ProductNameLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoProductName
            ),

        PublisherLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
            )

    | extend

        PathMatchKey = case(
            FolderPath contains "ChatGPT.app", "path:openai-chatgpt",
            FolderPath contains "Claude.app", "path:anthropic-claude",
            FolderPath contains "ClaudeCode.app", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            FolderPath contains "@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            ""
        )

    | extend

        MatchKeys = pack_array(
            iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
            PathMatchKey
        )

    | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        HasProductName = isnotempty(ProductNameLower),
        HasPublisher = isnotempty(PublisherLower),
        MatchKey
    | summarize by Timestamp, User, AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, ProcessNameLower, ProductNameLower, PublisherLower, HasProductName, HasPublisher, MatchKey

    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIProcesses

        | extend
            ProcessNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProcessName
                ),

            CatalogueProductNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProductName
                ),

            CataloguePublisherLower =
                tolower(
                    CataloguePublisher
                )

        | extend

            CataloguePathKey = case(
                PolicyKey == "openai-chatgpt", "path:openai-chatgpt",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude", "path:anthropic-claude",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                ""
            )

        | extend

            MatchKeys = pack_array(
                iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
                CataloguePathKey
            )

        | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

        | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

        | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    ) on MatchKey

    | where
        isempty(CatalogueProductName)
        or ProductNameLower ==
            CatalogueProductNameLower
        or not(HasProductName)

    | where
        isempty(CataloguePublisher)
        or PublisherLower has
            CataloguePublisherLower
        or not(HasPublisher)

    | where set_has_element(
        SanctionedPolicies,
        PolicyKey
    )

    | project PolicyKey;


// ============================================================
// OBSERVED SANCTIONED POLICIES
// ============================================================

let ObservedSanctioned =
    union
        NetworkObserved,
        DesktopObserved

    | distinct PolicyKey;


// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED BUT NOT OBSERVED
// ============================================================

SanctionedInventory

| join kind=leftanti (
    ObservedSanctioned
) on PolicyKey


// ============================================================
// FRIENDLY DISPLAY
// ============================================================

| extend ['Products Configured'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            ProductNames
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ['Domains / Indicators'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            Domains
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ['Processes'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            Processes
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ['Catalogue Source'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            CatalogueSources
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ProductTitle =
    strcat(
        "⚪ ",
        Provider,
        " - ",
        ['Products Configured']
    )


// ============================================================
// OUTPUT
// ============================================================

| project
    ProductTitle,

    Provider,

    ['Products Configured'],

    PolicyKey,

    ['Domains / Indicators'],

    ['Processes'],

    ['Catalogue Source']

| order by
    Provider asc,
    ProductTitle asc

content.json: This report provides a consolidated view of **AI usage observed across users and devices**, classifying activity as either 🟢 **Sanctioned** or 🔴 **Unsanctioned** based on the AI policies selected as approved above. Activity is further separated by how the service was accessed: **Web / Browser** for browser-based use, **API / Developer** for developer or API services, **Non-browser Network** for AI network connections originating from other processes, and **Desktop Client** for known AI applications observed executing on endpoints. Use the grouped results and column filters to identify unsanctioned AI adoption, understand how approved services are being consumed, and investigate the supporting users, devices, processes, URLs, and execution evidence. Results reflect activity within the selected **Time Range**.

content.query:
// ============================================================
// AI Compliance & Governance Review
//
// Governance:
//   🟢 Sanctioned
//   🔴 Unsanctioned
//
// Access Type:
//   Web / Browser
//   API / Developer
//   Non-browser Network
//   Desktop Client
//
// Evidence Type:
//   Network
//   Desktop Execution
//
// If no sanctioned applications are selected, all detected
// AI activity is classified as Unsanctioned.
// ============================================================

let PublicAIData = externaldata(
    Provider:string,
    Product:string,
    Domain:string,
    Category:string,
    Sanctioned:bool,
    RiskType:string,
    SourceURL:string,
    ProcessName:string,
    ProcessProductName:string,
    ProcessPublisher:string
)
[
    @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_domains.csv"
]
with (
    format="csv",
    ignoreFirstRecord=true
)
| extend Sanctioned=false, CatalogueSource="Public", SourcePriority=1
| extend PolicyKey=trim(@"^-+|-+$", replace_regex(tolower(strcat(Provider,"-",Product)), @"[^a-z0-9]+", "-"))
| extend MatchKey=case(
    isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
    isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
    strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
);

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend
        PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key),
        CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist",
        SourcePriority=2
    | extend MatchKey=case(
        isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
        isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );

let AIData =
    union PublicAIData, LocalAIData
    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)
    | summarize arg_max(SourcePriority, *) by MatchKey
    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        Sanctioned,
        RiskType,
        SourceURL,
        ProcessName,
        ProcessProductName,
        ProcessPublisher,
        PolicyKey,
        CatalogueSource;

let AIDomainData = AIData;

let AIDomains =
    toscalar(
        AIDomainData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | summarize make_set(Domain)
    );

let SanctionedPolicies =
    dynamic([{Sanctioned}]);

let Browsers = dynamic([
    "msedge.exe",
    "chrome.exe",
    "firefox.exe",
    "brave.exe",
    "opera.exe",
    "iexplore.exe"
]);

// ============================================================
// NETWORK EVIDENCE
// ============================================================

let NetworkEvidenceRaw =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
        or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where has_any_index(tolower(RemoteUrl), AIDomains) >= 0
    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(
            isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn),
            InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
            InitiatingProcessAccountName
        ),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        RemoteUrl,
        Process = InitiatingProcessFileName
    | extend RemoteUrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | extend UrlNoQuery = replace_regex(RemoteUrlLower, @"[?#].*$", "")
    | extend UrlNoScheme = replace_regex(UrlNoQuery, @"^https?://", "")
    | extend UrlMatchKeys = pack_array(
        strcat("host:", tostring(split(UrlNoScheme, "/")[0])),
        strcat("path:", UrlNoScheme)
    )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = UrlMatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", "")),
        User = tostring(column_ifexists("User", "")),
        DeviceId = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceId", "")),
        DeviceName = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
        RemoteUrl = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        Process = tostring(column_ifexists("Process", "")),
        MatchKey
    | distinct
        Timestamp,
        User,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        RemoteUrl,
        Process,
        MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | extend DomainKey =
            replace_regex(
                tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)),
                @"^https?://",
                ""
            )
        | extend DomainKey =
            replace_regex(
                DomainKey,
                @"/+$",
                ""
            )
        | extend DomainMatchKey =
            iff(
                DomainKey contains "/",
                strcat("path:", DomainKey),
                strcat("host:", DomainKey)
            )
        | project
            DomainMatchKey,
            Provider,
            Product,
            Domain,
            PolicyKey,
            Category,
            RiskType,
            SourceURL
        | distinct
            DomainMatchKey,
            Provider,
            Product,
            Domain,
            PolicyKey,
            Category,
            RiskType,
            SourceURL
    ) on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainMatchKey
    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(SanctionedPolicies) > 0
        and set_has_element(SanctionedPolicies, PolicyKey)
    | extend Governance =
        iff(IsSanctioned, "🟢 Sanctioned", "🔴 Unsanctioned")
    | extend IsBrowser = Process in~ (Browsers)
    | extend IsAPI =
        RiskType =~ "API"
        or Category =~ "API"
        or Product has "API"
    | extend IsDeveloper =
        RiskType =~ "Developer"
        or Category =~ "Developer"
    | extend AccessType =
        case(
            IsBrowser, "Web / Browser",
            IsAPI or IsDeveloper, "API / Developer",
            "Non-browser Network"
        )
    | extend EvidenceType = "Network"
    | project
        Timestamp,
        Governance,
        AccessType,
        EvidenceType,
        User,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        Process,
        RemoteUrl,
        InstallationType = "",
        EvidenceDetail = RemoteUrl,
        Version = "",
        Publisher = "",
        FolderPath = "",
        SourceURL;

// ============================================================
// DESKTOP CLIENT CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIProcesses =
    AIDomainData
    | where isnotempty(ProcessName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessProductName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessPublisher)
        or PolicyKey in (
            "openai-chatgpt",
            "anthropic-claude",
            "anthropic-claude-code"
        )
    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        PolicyKey,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        SourceURL,
        CatalogueProcessName = ProcessName,
        CatalogueProductName = ProcessProductName,
        CataloguePublisher = ProcessPublisher;

// ============================================================
// DESKTOP CLIENT EXECUTION EVIDENCE
// ============================================================

let DesktopEvidenceRaw =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | where isnotempty(AccountUpn)
        or isnotempty(AccountName)
    | extend
        ProcessFileName = tostring(column_ifexists("FileName", "")),
        ProcessProductNameValue = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessVersionInfoProductName", "")),
        ProcessPublisherValue = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName", "")),
        ProcessVersionValue = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessVersionInfoProductVersion", "")),
        FolderPath = tostring(column_ifexists("FolderPath", ""))
    | extend
        ProcessNameLower = tolower(ProcessFileName),
        ProductNameLower = tolower(ProcessProductNameValue),
        PublisherLower = tolower(ProcessPublisherValue)
    | extend
        PathMatchKey =
            case(
                FolderPath contains "ChatGPT.app",
                    "path:openai-chatgpt",
                FolderPath contains "Claude.app",
                    "path:anthropic-claude",
                FolderPath contains "ClaudeCode.app",
                    "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                FolderPath contains "@anthropic-ai/claude-code",
                    "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                ""
            )
    | extend
        MatchKeys = pack_array(
            iff(
                isnotempty(ProcessNameLower),
                strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower),
                ""
            ),
            PathMatchKey
        )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessFileName,
        ProcessProductNameValue,
        ProcessPublisherValue,
        ProcessVersionValue,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        FolderPath,
        HasProductName = isnotempty(ProductNameLower),
        HasPublisher = isnotempty(PublisherLower),
        MatchKey
    | summarize by
        Timestamp,
        User,
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessFileName,
        ProcessProductNameValue,
        ProcessPublisherValue,
        ProcessVersionValue,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        FolderPath,
        HasProductName,
        HasPublisher,
        MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIProcesses
        | extend
            ProcessNameLower = tolower(CatalogueProcessName),
            CatalogueProductNameLower = tolower(CatalogueProductName),
            CataloguePublisherLower = tolower(CataloguePublisher)
        | extend
            CataloguePathKey =
                case(
                    PolicyKey == "openai-chatgpt",
                        "path:openai-chatgpt",
                    PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude",
                        "path:anthropic-claude",
                    PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude-code",
                        "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                    ""
                )
        | extend
            MatchKeys = pack_array(
                iff(
                    isnotempty(ProcessNameLower),
                    strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower),
                    ""
                ),
                CataloguePathKey
            )
        | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys
        | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
        | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    ) on MatchKey
    | where
        isempty(CatalogueProductName)
        or ProductNameLower == CatalogueProductNameLower
        or not(HasProductName)
    | where
        isempty(CataloguePublisher)
        or PublisherLower has CataloguePublisherLower
        or not(HasPublisher)
    | extend InstallationType =
        case(
            FolderPath has @"\Program Files\WindowsApps\",
                "Microsoft Store / MSIX",
            FolderPath has @"\AppData\Local\Packages\",
                "User / Packaged Application",
            FolderPath has @"\AppData\Local\Programs\",
                "Per-user Installation",
            FolderPath has @"\Program Files (x86)\",
                "System Installation (x86)",
            FolderPath has @"\Program Files\",
                "System Installation",
            FolderPath has @"\AppData\",
                "User Profile",
            "Other / Unknown"
        )
    | extend EvidenceDetail =
        case(
            InstallationType == "Microsoft Store / MSIX",
                "Executed from Store / MSIX package",
            InstallationType == "User / Packaged Application",
                "Executed from user package",
            InstallationType == "Per-user Installation",
                "Executed from per-user installation",
            InstallationType startswith "System Installation",
                "Executed from system installation",
            "Client execution observed"
        )
    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(SanctionedPolicies) > 0
        and set_has_element(SanctionedPolicies, PolicyKey)
    | extend Governance =
        iff(IsSanctioned, "🟢 Sanctioned", "🔴 Unsanctioned")
    | extend
        AccessType = "Desktop Client",
        EvidenceType = "Desktop Execution"
    | project
        Timestamp,
        Governance,
        AccessType,
        EvidenceType,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        Process = ProcessFileName,
        RemoteUrl = "",
        InstallationType,
        EvidenceDetail,
        Version = ProcessVersionValue,
        Publisher = ProcessPublisherValue,
        FolderPath,
        SourceURL;

// ============================================================
// COMBINE NETWORK AND DESKTOP EVIDENCE
// ============================================================

union
    NetworkEvidenceRaw,
    DesktopEvidenceRaw
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Devices = dcount(DeviceId),
    DeviceList = make_set_if(DeviceName, isnotempty(DeviceName), 30),
    Processes = make_set_if(Process, isnotempty(Process), 30),
    RemoteURLs = make_set_if(RemoteUrl, isnotempty(RemoteUrl), 30),
    InstallationTypes = make_set_if(InstallationType, isnotempty(InstallationType), 10),
    EvidenceDetails = make_set_if(EvidenceDetail, isnotempty(EvidenceDetail), 20),
    Versions = make_set_if(Version, isnotempty(Version), 20),
    Publishers = make_set_if(Publisher, isnotempty(Publisher), 20),
    Paths = make_set_if(FolderPath, isnotempty(FolderPath), 30),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
  by
    Governance,
    AccessType,
    EvidenceType,
    User,
    Provider,
    Product,
    Domain,
    Category,
    RiskType,
    SourceURL
| extend AIService = strcat(Provider, " - ", Product)
| extend GovernanceSort =
    case(
        Governance == "🔴 Unsanctioned", 1,
        Governance == "🟢 Sanctioned", 2,
        3
    )
| extend AccessSort =
    case(
        AccessType == "API / Developer", 1,
        AccessType == "Non-browser Network", 2,
        AccessType == "Desktop Client", 3,
        AccessType == "Web / Browser", 4,
        5
    )
| order by
    GovernanceSort asc,
    AccessSort asc,
    Events desc,
    User asc,
    Provider asc,
    Product asc
| project
    Governance,
    ['Access Type'] = AccessType,
    ['Evidence Type'] = EvidenceType,
    User,
    ['AI Service'] = AIService,
    Provider,
    Product,
    Domain,
    Category,
    ['Risk Type'] = RiskType,
    Devices,
    ['Device List'] = DeviceList,
    Events,
    Processes,
    ['Remote URLs'] = RemoteURLs,
    ['Installation Types'] = InstallationTypes,
    ['Evidence Details'] = EvidenceDetails,
    Versions,
    Publishers,
    Paths,
    ['First Seen'] = FirstSeen,
    ['Last Seen'] = LastSeen,
    SourceURL

content.query:
// ============================================================
// MULTI-AI PRODUCT USAGE
//
// Uses Workbook TimeRange.
//
// Governance:
//   🟢 Sanctioned only
//   🟠 Mixed
//   🔴 Unsanctioned only
//
// Includes:
//   - Web / browser activity
//   - Desktop / client activity
//
// Output:
//   One row per user where more than one AI product
//   was observed during the selected TimeRange.
