// ============================================================
// AI SERVICE CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let PublicAIData = externaldata(
    Provider:string,
    Product:string,
    Domain:string,
    Category:string,
    Sanctioned:bool,
    RiskType:string,
    SourceURL:string,
    ProcessName:string,
    ProcessProductName:string,
    ProcessPublisher:string
)
[
    @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_domains.csv"
]
with (
    format="csv",
    ignoreFirstRecord=true
)
| extend
    Sanctioned = false,
    CatalogueSource = "Public",
    SourcePriority = 1
| extend PolicyKey =
    trim(
        @"^-+|-+$",
        replace_regex(
            tolower(
                strcat(
                    Provider,
                    "-",
                    Product
                )
            ),
            @"[^a-z0-9]+",
            "-"
        )
    )
| extend MatchKey =
    case(
        isnotempty(Domain),
            strcat(
                "domain:",
                tolower(
                    trim(
                        @"^\s+|\s+$",
                        Domain
                    )
                )
            ),

        isnotempty(ProcessName),
            strcat(
                "process:",
                tolower(
                    trim(
                        @"^\s+|\s+$",
                        ProcessName
                    )
                )
            ),

        strcat(
            "product:",
            tolower(
                trim(
                    @"^\s+|\s+$",
                    Provider
                )
            ),
            "|",
            tolower(
                trim(
                    @"^\s+|\s+$",
                    Product
                )
            )
        )
    );


// ============================================================
// OPTIONAL LOCAL WATCHLIST
// ============================================================

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key), CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist", SourcePriority=2
    | extend MatchKey=case(
        isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
        isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );


// ============================================================
// EFFECTIVE AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIData =
    union
        PublicAIData,
        LocalAIData

    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)

    | summarize
        arg_max(
            SourcePriority,
            *
        )
      by MatchKey

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        Sanctioned,
        RiskType,
        SourceURL,
        ProcessName,
        ProcessProductName,
        ProcessPublisher,
        PolicyKey,
        CatalogueSource;


// ============================================================
// KNOWN AI DOMAINS
// ============================================================

let AIDomains =
    toscalar(
        AIData

        | where isnotempty(Domain)

        | summarize
            make_set(
                Domain,
                1000
            )
    );


// ============================================================
// CUSTOMER-SELECTED SANCTIONED SERVICES
//
// Empty selection means all observed AI is unsanctioned.
// ============================================================

let SanctionedPolicies =
    dynamic([{Sanctioned}]);


// ============================================================
// KNOWN BROWSERS
// ============================================================

let Browsers = dynamic([
    "msedge.exe",
    "chrome.exe",
    "firefox.exe",
    "brave.exe",
    "opera.exe",
    "iexplore.exe"
]);


// ============================================================
// WEB / DOMAIN ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let WebActivity =
    DeviceNetworkEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | where has_any_index(tolower(RemoteUrl), AIDomains) >= 0

    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
        Browsers
    )

    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn), InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        DeviceName,
        RemoteUrl

    | extend RemoteUrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | extend UrlNoQuery = replace_regex(RemoteUrlLower, @"[?#].*$", "")
    | extend UrlNoScheme = replace_regex(UrlNoQuery, @"^https?://", "")
    | extend UrlMatchKeys = pack_array(
        strcat("host:", tostring(split(UrlNoScheme, "/")[0])),
        strcat("path:", UrlNoScheme)
    )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = UrlMatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", "")),
        User = tostring(column_ifexists("User", "")),
        DeviceId = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceId", "")),
        DeviceName = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
        RemoteUrl = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        Process = tostring(column_ifexists("Process", "")),
        MatchKey
    | distinct Timestamp, User, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, Process, MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)), @"^https?://", "")
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(DomainKey, @"/+$", "")
        | extend DomainMatchKey = iff(DomainKey contains "/", strcat("path:", DomainKey), strcat("host:", DomainKey))
        | project DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
        | distinct DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
    ) on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainMatchKey

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | summarize
        Events = count(),
        FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
        LastSeen = max(Timestamp)

      by
        User,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        IsSanctioned

    | project
        User,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        IsSanctioned,
        ActivityType = "Web / Browser",
        Events,
        FirstSeen,
        LastSeen;


// ============================================================
// PROCESS / CLIENT CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIProcesses =
    AIData

    | where isnotempty(ProcessName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessProductName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessPublisher)
        or PolicyKey in (
            "openai-chatgpt",
            "anthropic-claude",
            "anthropic-claude-code"
        )

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        PolicyKey,
        Category,
        RiskType,

        CatalogueProcessName =
            ProcessName,

        CatalogueProductName =
            ProcessProductName,

        CataloguePublisher =
            ProcessPublisher;


// ============================================================
// PROCESS / CLIENT ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let ProcessActivity =
    DeviceProcessEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )

    | where isnotempty(AccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(AccountName)

    | extend
        ProcessNameLower =
            tolower(FileName),

        ProductNameLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoProductName
            ),

        PublisherLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
            )

    | extend

        PathMatchKey = case(
            FolderPath contains "ChatGPT.app", "path:openai-chatgpt",
            FolderPath contains "Claude.app", "path:anthropic-claude",
            FolderPath contains "ClaudeCode.app", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            FolderPath contains "@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            ""
        )

    | extend

        MatchKeys = pack_array(
            iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
            PathMatchKey
        )

    | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        HasProductName = isnotempty(ProductNameLower),
        HasPublisher = isnotempty(PublisherLower),
        MatchKey
    | summarize by Timestamp, User, AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, ProcessNameLower, ProductNameLower, PublisherLower, HasProductName, HasPublisher, MatchKey

    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIProcesses

        | extend
            ProcessNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProcessName
                ),

            CatalogueProductNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProductName
                ),

            CataloguePublisherLower =
                tolower(
                    CataloguePublisher
                )

        | extend

            CataloguePathKey = case(
                PolicyKey == "openai-chatgpt", "path:openai-chatgpt",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude", "path:anthropic-claude",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                ""
            )

        | extend

            MatchKeys = pack_array(
                iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
                CataloguePathKey
            )

        | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

        | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

        | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    ) on MatchKey

    | where
        isempty(
            CatalogueProductName
        )
        or ProductNameLower
            == CatalogueProductNameLower
        or not(HasProductName)

    | where
        isempty(
            CataloguePublisher
        )
        or PublisherLower has
            CataloguePublisherLower
        or not(HasPublisher)

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | summarize
        Events = count(),
        FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
        LastSeen = max(Timestamp)

      by
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        IsSanctioned

    | project
        User,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        IsSanctioned,
        ActivityType = "Desktop Client",
        Events,
        FirstSeen,
        LastSeen;


// ============================================================
// COMBINED AI USAGE
// ============================================================

union
    WebActivity,
    ProcessActivity

// Decorate each observed product before aggregation so
// governance remains visible in the final product list.
| extend ProductDisplay =
    strcat(
        iff(
            IsSanctioned,
            "🟢 ",
            "🔴 "
        ),
        Product
    )

| summarize

    AIProducts =
        dcount(PolicyKey),

    AIProviders =
        dcount(Provider),

    SanctionedProducts =
        dcountif(
            PolicyKey,
            IsSanctioned
        ),

    UnsanctionedProducts =
        dcountif(
            PolicyKey,
            not(IsSanctioned)
        ),

    ProductsObserved =
        make_set(
            ProductDisplay,
            50
        ),

    ProvidersUsed =
        make_set(
            Provider,
            50
        ),

    ActivityTypes =
        make_set(
            ActivityType,
            10
        ),

    RiskTypes =
        make_set(
            RiskType,
            20
        ),

    Categories =
        make_set(
            Category,
            20
        ),

    Devices =
        dcount(DeviceName),

    DeviceList =
        make_set(
            DeviceName,
            50
        ),

    Events =
        sum(Events),

    FirstSeen =
        min(FirstSeen),

    LastSeen =
        max(LastSeen)

  by User


// ============================================================
// ONLY USERS WITH MULTIPLE AI PRODUCTS
// ============================================================

| where AIProducts > 1


// ============================================================
// GOVERNANCE
// ============================================================

| extend Governance =
    case(
        SanctionedProducts > 0
            and UnsanctionedProducts > 0,
            "🟠 Mixed",

        UnsanctionedProducts > 0,
            "🔴 Unsanctioned only",

        SanctionedProducts > 0,
            "🟢 Sanctioned only",

        "⚪ Review"
    )


// ============================================================
// USAGE PROFILE
// ============================================================

| extend UsageProfile =
    case(
        AIProducts >= 5,
            "5+ AI products",

        AIProducts >= 3,
            "3-4 AI products",

        "2 AI products"
    )


// ============================================================
// FRIENDLY LISTS
// ============================================================

| extend ['Products Observed'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            ProductsObserved
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ['Providers Used'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            ProvidersUsed
        ),
        ", "
    )

| extend ['Activity Types'] =
    strcat_array(
        array_sort_asc(
            ActivityTypes
        ),
        ", "
    )


// ============================================================
// SORT
// ============================================================

| extend GovernanceSort =
    case(
        Governance == "🔴 Unsanctioned only", 1,
        Governance == "🟠 Mixed", 2,
        Governance == "🟢 Sanctioned only", 3,
        4
    )

| order by
    GovernanceSort asc,
    AIProducts desc,
    AIProviders desc,
    Events desc


// ============================================================
// OUTPUT
// ============================================================

| project
    Governance,

    User,

    ['AI Products'] =
        AIProducts,

    ['Sanctioned Products'] =
        SanctionedProducts,

    ['Unsanctioned Products'] =
        UnsanctionedProducts,

    ['AI Providers'] =
        AIProviders,

    ['Usage Profile'] =
        UsageProfile,

    ['Products Observed'],

    ['Providers Used'],

    ['Activity Types'],

    ['Risk Types'] =
        RiskTypes,

    Categories,

    Devices,

    ['Device List'] =
        DeviceList,

    Events,

    ['First Seen'] =
        FirstSeen,

    ['Last Seen'] =
        LastSeen
content.title: 🔀 Multi-AI Product Usage, count: {$rowCount}

content.json: **Multi-AI Product Usage** identifies users observed accessing **multiple different AI products or providers** across web and desktop client activity within the selected **Time Range**. Users are classified as 🟢 **Sanctioned only**, 🟠 **Mixed**, or 🔴 **Unsanctioned only**, with separate counts showing sanctioned and unsanctioned products. Use this view to identify broad AI adoption, use of multiple competing services, and potentially unmanaged or duplicated AI tooling.

content.title: 📈 AI Usage & Adoption - {$rowCount} Products

content.json: **AI Usage & Adoption** shows how regularly recognised AI products were observed during the selected **Time Range**, including active days, users, devices, observed sessions and activity volume. **Active Days** shows the number of days with observed activity against the total selected period (for example, *12 of 30 days*). **Observed Sessions** are inferred from telemetry using periods of activity separated by more than 30 minutes and should be treated as an indication of usage patterns rather than actual time spent using a service.

content.query:
// ============================================================
// AI USAGE BY USER
//
// Shows how regularly each user has been observed using AI
// during the selected Workbook TimeRange.
//
// Measures:
//   - Governance
//   - Active Days
//   - AI Products
//   - AI Providers
//   - Sanctioned / Unsanctioned Products
//   - Observed Sessions
//   - Activity Events
//   - Devices
//   - First / Last Seen
//
// IMPORTANT:
// "Observed Sessions" are inferred from telemetry.
// A new session starts where more than 30 minutes has elapsed
// since the previous observation for the same user/product.
//
// This is NOT a measure of foreground application time or
// actual time spent using an AI service.
// ============================================================


// ============================================================
// TIME RANGE
// ============================================================

let RangeStart =
    todatetime({TimeRange:start});

let RangeEnd =
    todatetime({TimeRange:end});

let RangeDays =
    datetime_diff(
        "day",
        startofday(RangeEnd),
        startofday(RangeStart)
    ) + 1;


// ============================================================
// PUBLIC AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let PublicAIData =
    externaldata(
        Provider:string,
        Product:string,
        Domain:string,
        Category:string,
        Sanctioned:bool,
        RiskType:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        ProcessName:string,
        ProcessProductName:string,
        ProcessPublisher:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_domains.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )

    | extend
        Sanctioned = false,
        CatalogueSource = "Public",
        SourcePriority = 1

    | extend PolicyKey =
        trim(
            @"^-+|-+$",
            replace_regex(
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        Provider,
                        "-",
                        Product
                    )
                ),
                @"[^a-z0-9]+",
                "-"
            )
        )

    | extend MatchKey =
        case(
            isnotempty(Domain),
                strcat(
                    "domain:",
                    tolower(
                        trim(
                            @"^\s+|\s+$",
                            Domain
                        )
                    )
                ),

            isnotempty(ProcessName),
                strcat(
                    "process:",
                    tolower(
                        trim(
                            @"^\s+|\s+$",
                            ProcessName
                        )
                    )
                ),

            strcat(
                "product:",
                tolower(
                    trim(
                        @"^\s+|\s+$",
                        Provider
                    )
                ),
                "|",
                tolower(
                    trim(
                        @"^\s+|\s+$",
                        Product
                    )
                )
            )
        );


// ============================================================
// OPTIONAL LOCAL AIGOVERNANCE WATCHLIST
// ============================================================

let LocalAIData =
    _GetWatchlist('AIGovernance')
    | extend
        W = todynamic(column_ifexists("WatchlistItem", "")),
        DirectKey = tostring(column_ifexists("Key", "")),
        DirectPolicyKey = tostring(column_ifexists("PolicyKey", "")),
        DirectProvider = tostring(column_ifexists("Provider", "")),
        DirectProduct = tostring(column_ifexists("Product", "")),
        DirectDomain = tostring(column_ifexists("Domain", "")),
        DirectCategory = tostring(column_ifexists("Category", "")),
        DirectSanctioned = tostring(column_ifexists("Sanctioned", "")),
        DirectRiskType = tostring(column_ifexists("RiskType", "")),
        DirectSourceURL = tostring(column_ifexists("SourceURL", "")),
        DirectProcessName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessName", "")),
        DirectProcessProductName = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessProductName", "")),
        DirectProcessPublisher = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessPublisher", "")),
        DirectSearchKey = tostring(column_ifexists("SearchKey", ""))
    | project
        Key = iff(isnotempty(DirectKey), DirectKey, iff(isnotempty(tostring(W.Key)), tostring(W.Key), DirectSearchKey)),
        PolicyKey = iff(isnotempty(DirectPolicyKey), DirectPolicyKey, tostring(W.PolicyKey)),
        Provider = iff(isnotempty(DirectProvider), DirectProvider, tostring(W.Provider)),
        Product = iff(isnotempty(DirectProduct), DirectProduct, tostring(W.Product)),
        Domain = iff(isnotempty(DirectDomain), DirectDomain, tostring(W.Domain)),
        Category = iff(isnotempty(DirectCategory), DirectCategory, tostring(W.Category)),
        Sanctioned = iff(isnotempty(DirectSanctioned), tobool(DirectSanctioned), tobool(W.Sanctioned)),
        RiskType = iff(isnotempty(DirectRiskType), DirectRiskType, tostring(W.RiskType)),
        SourceURL = iff(isnotempty(DirectSourceURL), DirectSourceURL, tostring(W.SourceURL)),
        ProcessName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessName), DirectProcessName, tostring(W.ProcessName)),
        ProcessProductName = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessProductName), DirectProcessProductName, tostring(W.ProcessProductName)),
        ProcessPublisher = iff(isnotempty(DirectProcessPublisher), DirectProcessPublisher, tostring(W.ProcessPublisher))
    | extend PolicyKey=iff(isnotempty(PolicyKey),PolicyKey,Key), CatalogueSource="Local Watchlist", SourcePriority=2
    | extend MatchKey=case(
        isnotempty(Domain), strcat("domain:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Domain))),
        isnotempty(ProcessName), strcat("process:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",ProcessName))),
        strcat("product:",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Provider)),"|",tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$",Product)))
    );


// ============================================================
// EFFECTIVE AI CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIData =
    union
        PublicAIData,
        LocalAIData

    | where isnotempty(PolicyKey)

    | summarize
        arg_max(
            SourcePriority,
            *
        )
      by MatchKey

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        Domain,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        ProcessName,
        ProcessProductName,
        ProcessPublisher,
        PolicyKey,
        CatalogueSource;


// ============================================================
// CUSTOMER-SELECTED SANCTIONED POLICIES
// ============================================================

let SanctionedPolicies =
    dynamic([{Sanctioned}]);


// ============================================================
// KNOWN AI DOMAINS
// ============================================================

let AIDomains =
    toscalar(
        AIData

        | where isnotempty(Domain)

        | summarize
            make_set(
                Domain,
                1000
            )
    );


// ============================================================
// NETWORK ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let NetworkActivity =
    DeviceNetworkEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        RangeStart
        ..
        RangeEnd
    )

    | where isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountName)

    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)

    | where has_any_index(tolower(RemoteUrl), AIDomains) >= 0

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn), InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, InitiatingProcessAccountName),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        RemoteUrl

    | extend RemoteUrlLower = tolower(RemoteUrl)
    | extend UrlNoQuery = replace_regex(RemoteUrlLower, @"[?#].*$", "")
    | extend UrlNoScheme = replace_regex(UrlNoQuery, @"^https?://", "")
    | extend UrlMatchKeys = pack_array(
        strcat("host:", tostring(split(UrlNoScheme, "/")[0])),
        strcat("path:", UrlNoScheme)
    )
    | mv-expand MatchKey = UrlMatchKeys
    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)
    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)
    | project
        Timestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", "")),
        User = tostring(column_ifexists("User", "")),
        DeviceId = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceId", "")),
        DeviceName = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
        RemoteUrl = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        Process = tostring(column_ifexists("Process", "")),
        MatchKey
    | distinct Timestamp, User, DeviceId, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, Process, MatchKey
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIData
        | where isnotempty(Domain)
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(tolower(trim(@"^\s+|\s+$", Domain)), @"^https?://", "")
        | extend DomainKey = replace_regex(DomainKey, @"/+$", "")
        | extend DomainMatchKey = iff(DomainKey contains "/", strcat("path:", DomainKey), strcat("host:", DomainKey))
        | project DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
        | distinct DomainMatchKey, Provider, Product, Domain, PolicyKey, Category, RiskType
    ) on $left.MatchKey == $right.DomainMatchKey

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        IsSanctioned,
        EvidenceType = "Network";


// ============================================================
// PROCESS CATALOGUE
// ============================================================

let AIProcesses =
    AIData

    | where isnotempty(ProcessName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessProductName)
        or isnotempty(ProcessPublisher)
        or PolicyKey in (
            "openai-chatgpt",
            "anthropic-claude",
            "anthropic-claude-code"
        )

    | project
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,

        CatalogueProcessName =
            ProcessName,

        CatalogueProductName =
            ProcessProductName,

        CataloguePublisher =
            ProcessPublisher;


// ============================================================
// DESKTOP / CLIENT ACTIVITY
// ============================================================

let DesktopActivity =
    DeviceProcessEvents

    | where Timestamp between (
        RangeStart
        ..
        RangeEnd
    )

    | where isnotempty(AccountUpn)
    or isnotempty(AccountName)

    | extend
        ProcessNameLower =
            tolower(FileName),

        ProductNameLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoProductName
            ),

        PublisherLower =
            tolower(
                ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
            )

    | extend

        PathMatchKey = case(
            FolderPath contains "ChatGPT.app", "path:openai-chatgpt",
            FolderPath contains "Claude.app", "path:anthropic-claude",
            FolderPath contains "ClaudeCode.app", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            FolderPath contains "@anthropic-ai/claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
            ""
        )

    | extend

        MatchKeys = pack_array(
            iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
            PathMatchKey
        )

    | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

    | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

    | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        AccountUpn,
        AccountName,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessNameLower,
        ProductNameLower,
        PublisherLower,
        HasProductName = isnotempty(ProductNameLower),
        HasPublisher = isnotempty(PublisherLower),
        MatchKey
    | summarize by Timestamp, User, AccountUpn, AccountName, DeviceId, DeviceName, ProcessNameLower, ProductNameLower, PublisherLower, HasProductName, HasPublisher, MatchKey

    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AIProcesses

        | extend
            ProcessNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProcessName
                ),

            CatalogueProductNameLower =
                tolower(
                    CatalogueProductName
                ),

            CataloguePublisherLower =
                tolower(
                    CataloguePublisher
                )

        | extend

            CataloguePathKey = case(
                PolicyKey == "openai-chatgpt", "path:openai-chatgpt",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude", "path:anthropic-claude",
                PolicyKey == "anthropic-claude-code", "path:anthropic-claude-code",
                ""
            )

        | extend

            MatchKeys = pack_array(
                iff(isnotempty(ProcessNameLower), strcat("process:", ProcessNameLower), ""),
                CataloguePathKey
            )

        | mv-expand MatchKey = MatchKeys

        | extend MatchKey = tostring(MatchKey)

        | where isnotempty(MatchKey)

    ) on MatchKey

    | where
        isempty(CatalogueProductName)
        or ProductNameLower
            == CatalogueProductNameLower
        or not(HasProductName)

    | where
        isempty(CataloguePublisher)
        or PublisherLower has
            CataloguePublisherLower
        or not(HasPublisher)

    | extend IsSanctioned =
        array_length(
            SanctionedPolicies
        ) > 0
        and set_has_element(
            SanctionedPolicies,
            PolicyKey
        )

    | project
        Timestamp,
        User = iff(isnotempty(AccountUpn), AccountUpn, AccountName),
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        Provider,
        Product,
        PolicyKey,
        IsSanctioned,
        EvidenceType = "Desktop Client";


// ============================================================
// COMBINED OBSERVATIONS
// ============================================================

let Observations =
    union
        NetworkActivity,
        DesktopActivity

    | where isnotempty(User)
        and isnotempty(PolicyKey)

    // Remove duplicate catalogue/evidence matches for the same
    // telemetry moment.
    | summarize
        Provider =
            take_any(Provider),

        Product =
            take_any(Product),

        IsSanctioned =
            max(IsSanctioned),

        EvidenceTypes =
            make_set(
                EvidenceType,
                10
            )

      by
        Timestamp,
        User,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        PolicyKey;


// ============================================================
// SESSION DETECTION
//
// Sessions are calculated separately for each User + PolicyKey.
//
// A new observed session begins if:
//   - this is the first observation, OR
//   - more than 30 minutes elapsed since the previous event.
//
// This is telemetry-based sessionisation, NOT measured
// foreground usage duration.
// ============================================================

let SessionActivity =
    Observations

    | sort by
        User asc,
        PolicyKey asc,
        Timestamp asc

    | serialize

    | extend
        PreviousUser =
            prev(User),

        PreviousPolicyKey =
            prev(PolicyKey),

        PreviousTimestamp =
            prev(Timestamp)

    | extend IsNewSession =
        iff(
            User != PreviousUser
            or PolicyKey != PreviousPolicyKey
            or isnull(PreviousTimestamp)
            or Timestamp >
                PreviousTimestamp + 30m,
            1,
            0
        );


// ============================================================
// USER / PRODUCT SUMMARY
//
// Collapse evidence into one logical PolicyKey per user.
// ============================================================

let UserProducts =
    SessionActivity

    | summarize
        Provider =
            take_any(Provider),

        ProductNames =
            make_set(
                Product,
                20
            ),

        IsSanctioned =
            max(IsSanctioned),

        ActiveDays =
            dcount(
                startofday(Timestamp)
            ),

        Sessions =
            sum(IsNewSession),

        Events =
            count(),

        FirstSeen =
            min(Timestamp),

        LastSeen =
            max(Timestamp),

        Devices =
            dcount(DeviceId),

        DeviceList =
            make_set_if(
                DeviceName,
                isnotempty(DeviceName),
                50
            ),

        EvidenceTypes =
            make_set(
                EvidenceTypes,
                20
            )

      by
        User,
        PolicyKey

    | extend ProductLabel =
        strcat(
            iff(
                IsSanctioned,
                "🟢 ",
                "🔴 "
            ),
            strcat_array(
                array_sort_asc(
                    ProductNames
                ),
                " / "
            )
        );


// ============================================================
// USER SUMMARY
// ============================================================

UserProducts

| summarize

    AIProducts =
        dcount(PolicyKey),

    AIProviders =
        dcount(Provider),

    SanctionedProducts =
        dcountif(
            PolicyKey,
            IsSanctioned
        ),

    UnsanctionedProducts =
        dcountif(
            PolicyKey,
            not(IsSanctioned)
        ),

    ProductsObserved =
        make_set(
            ProductLabel,
            50
        ),

    ProvidersUsed =
        make_set(
            Provider,
            50
        ),

    ActiveDays =
        dcount(
            startofday(FirstSeen)
        ),

    ObservedSessions =
        sum(Sessions),

    ActivityEvents =
        sum(Events),

    Devices =
        max(Devices),

    DeviceList =
        make_set(
            DeviceList,
            50
        ),

    FirstSeen =
        min(FirstSeen),

    LastSeen =
        max(LastSeen)

  by User


// ============================================================
// ACTIVE DAYS
//

    | project

        User,

        Category,
        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,
        SourceURL,
        Vendor,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        MatchedOn,
        Pattern,

        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;

// ============================================================
// COMMAND-LINE MATCHES
// ============================================================

let CommandLineMatches =
    CandidateProcesses
    | where isnotempty(ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend JoinKey = 1
    | join kind=inner (

        | where MatchField =~ "ProcessCommandLine"

    | extend

                MatchType =~ "Wildcard",
                    CommandLineLower contains SearchPattern,

        User,
        Name,
        Category,
        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,
        SourceURL,
        Vendor,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        Pattern,

        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;

// ============================================================

    union
        FileNameMatches,
        CommandLineMatches
    | summarize
        MatchedFields =
            make_set(
                MatchedOn,
                10
            ),

        MatchedPatterns =
            make_set(
                Pattern,
                50
            ),

        MatchedSources =
            make_set(
                SourceURL,
                10
            )
      by
        EventKey,
        Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        User,

        Name,
        Vendor,
        Category,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,

        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;


// ============================================================
// LOCAL AI AGENT GOVERNANCE AT A GLANCE
// ============================================================

    EventMatches
    | extend AgentKey = replace_regex(tolower(tostring(Name)), "[^a-z0-9]", "")
    | summarize by AgentKey;
let LocalConfiguredCount =
    toscalar(
        AgentWatchlist
        | extend AgentKey = replace_regex(tolower(tostring(Name)), "[^a-z0-9]", "")
        | where SourceFrom =~ "Local"
        | where set_has_element(SelectedAgentKeys, AgentKey)
        | summarize dcount(AgentKey)
    );
let LocalSanctionedObserved =
    toscalar(
        LocalObservedAgents
        | where set_has_element(SelectedAgentKeys, AgentKey)
        | summarize dcount(AgentKey)
    );
let LocalUnsanctionedObserved =
    toscalar(
        LocalObservedAgents
        | where set_has_element(SelectedAgentKeys, AgentKey) == false
        | summarize dcount(AgentKey)
    );
let LocalSanctionedNotObserved =
    iff(LocalConfiguredCount > LocalSanctionedObserved, LocalConfiguredCount - LocalSanctionedObserved, 0);
union
    (print SortOrder = 1, Metric = "🟢 Sanctioned Agents Observed", Value = tolong(LocalSanctionedObserved), Detail = "Selected local agents with evidence in the period"),
    (print SortOrder = 2, Metric = "🔴 Unsanctioned Agents Observed", Value = tolong(LocalUnsanctionedObserved), Detail = "Recognised local agents not in the selection"),
    (print SortOrder = 3, Metric = "⚪ Sanctioned Agents Not Observed", Value = tolong(LocalSanctionedNotObserved), Detail = "Selected local agents with no evidence in the period")
| order by SortOrder asc
| project Metric, Value, Detail

// ============================================================
// AI AGENT / TOOL DETECTION
//
// Reads ai_agent_watchlist.csv.
// Matches LOCAL agents and runtimes against DeviceProcessEvents.
//
// Cloud rows are excluded because cloud agents require separate
// telemetry such as OfficeActivity, Security Copilot, Entra,
// Purview, or vendor APIs.
// ============================================================

// ============================================================
// AI AGENT WATCHLIST
// ============================================================

let AgentWatchlist =
    externaldata(
        Name:string,
        Category:string,
        MatchField:string,
        Pattern:string,
        MatchType:string,
        RiskLevel:string,
        DefaultAction:string,
        Reason:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        Vendor:string,
        SourceFrom:string,
        TelemetrySource:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_agent_watchlist.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )
    | extend
        SearchPattern =
            tolower(
                case(
                    MatchType =~ "Wildcard",
                        replace_string(
                            replace_string(Pattern, "*", ""),
                            "?",
                            ""
                        ),
                    Pattern
                )
            )
    | where SourceFrom =~ "Local"
    | where MatchField in~ (
        "FileName",
        "ProcessCommandLine"
    )
    | where TelemetrySource contains "DeviceProcessEvents"
    | where isnotempty(SearchPattern);

// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED AI AGENT POLICY KEYS
// ============================================================
let SanctionedAgents =
    dynamic([{SanctionedAgents}]);

let SelectedAgentKeys =
    toscalar(
        print SelectedValue = SanctionedAgents
        | mv-expand SelectedValue
        | extend SelectedKey =
            replace_regex(
                tolower(tostring(SelectedValue)),
                "[^a-z0-9]",
                ""
            )
        | where isnotempty(SelectedKey)
        | summarize make_set(SelectedKey, 500)
    );

// ============================================================
// BUILD SEARCH LIST
// ============================================================

let WatchPatterns =
    toscalar(
        AgentWatchlist
        | summarize make_set(SearchPattern, 500)
    );

// ============================================================
// CANDIDATE PROCESS EVENTS
// ============================================================
let CandidateProcesses =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )
    | where isnotempty(DeviceName)
    | extend
        FileNameLower =
            tolower(
                coalesce(
                    FileName,
                    ""
                )
            ),
        CommandLineLower =
            tolower(
                coalesce(
                    ProcessCommandLine,
                    ""
                )
            ),
        SearchText =
            tolower(
                strcat(
                    FileName,
                    " ",
                    FolderPath,
                    " ",
                    ProcessCommandLine,
                    " ",
                    ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
                    " ",
                    ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName
                )
            )
    | where SearchText has_any(WatchPatterns)
    | extend
        EventKey =
            strcat(
                tostring(Timestamp),
                "|",
                tostring(DeviceId),
                "|",
                tostring(FileName),
                "|",
                tostring(ProcessCommandLine)
            )
    | project
        EventKey,
        Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        User =
            tostring(
                coalesce(
                    InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
                    InitiatingProcessAccountName
                )
            ),
        FileName,
        FileNameLower,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,
        CommandLineLower,
        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
        SHA256;

// ============================================================
// FILENAME MATCHES
// ============================================================

let FileNameMatches =
    CandidateProcesses
    | extend JoinKey = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        AgentWatchlist
        | where MatchField =~ "FileName"
        | extend JoinKey = 1
    ) on JoinKey
    | extend
        IsMatch =
            case(
                MatchType =~ "Exact",
                    FileNameLower == SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Contains",
                    FileNameLower contains SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Wildcard",
                    FileNameLower contains SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Prefix",
                    FileNameLower startswith SearchPattern,

                false
            )
    | where IsMatch
    | extend
        MatchedOn = "FileName"
    | project
        EventKey,
        Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        User,

        Name,
        Category,
        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,
        SourceURL,
        Vendor,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        MatchedOn,
        Pattern,

        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;

// ============================================================
// COMMAND-LINE MATCHES
// ============================================================

let CommandLineMatches =
    CandidateProcesses
    | where isnotempty(ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend JoinKey = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        AgentWatchlist
        | where MatchField =~ "ProcessCommandLine"
        | extend JoinKey = 1
    ) on JoinKey
    | extend
        IsMatch =
            case(
                MatchType =~ "Exact",
                    CommandLineLower == SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Contains",
                    CommandLineLower contains SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Wildcard",
                    CommandLineLower contains SearchPattern,

                MatchType =~ "Prefix",
                    CommandLineLower startswith SearchPattern,

                false
            )
    | where IsMatch
    | extend
        MatchedOn = "ProcessCommandLine"
    | project
        EventKey,
        Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        User,
        Name,
        Category,
        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,
        SourceURL,
        Vendor,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        MatchedOn,
        Pattern,

        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;

// ============================================================
// COMBINE AND DEDUPLICATE EVENT MATCHES
// ============================================================

let EventMatches =
    union
        FileNameMatches,
        CommandLineMatches
    | summarize
        MatchedFields =
            make_set(
                MatchedOn,
                10
            ),

        MatchedPatterns =
            make_set(
                Pattern,
                50
            ),

        MatchedSources =
            make_set(
                SourceURL,
                10
            )
      by
        EventKey,
        Timestamp,
        DeviceId,
        DeviceName,
        User,

        Name,
        Vendor,
        Category,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,

        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,

        FileName,
        FolderPath,
        ProcessCommandLine,

        ProcessVersionInfoProductName,
        ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,

        SHA256;

// ============================================================
// SUMMARISE BY TOOL
// ============================================================
EventMatches
| extend
    ToolKey =
        strcat_array(
            extract_all(
                "([A-Za-z0-9]+)",
                tostring(Name)
            ),
            ""
        )
| summarize
    ToolName = take_any(Name),
    ToolVendor = take_any(Vendor),
    ToolFrom = take_any(SourceFrom),
    ToolTelemetrySource = take_any(TelemetrySource),
    ToolCategory = take_any(Category),
    ToolRiskLevel = take_any(RiskLevel),
    ToolDefaultAction = take_any(DefaultAction),
    ToolReason = take_any(Reason),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    Events = dcount(EventKey),
    Users =
        dcountif(
            User,
            isnotempty(User)
        ),
    Devices = dcount(DeviceId),
    UserList =
        make_set_if(
            User,
            isnotempty(User),
            30
        ),
    DeviceList =
        make_set_if(
            DeviceName,
            isnotempty(DeviceName),
            30
        ),
    MatchFields =
        make_set(
            strcat_array(MatchedFields, ", "),
            10
        ),
    Patterns =
        make_set(
            strcat_array(MatchedPatterns, ", "),
            50
        ),
    Sources =
        make_set(
            strcat_array(MatchedSources, ", "),
            10
        ),
    ExampleProcess =
        take_any(FileName),
    ExampleCommandLine =
        take_any(ProcessCommandLine),
    ExampleProduct =
        take_any(ProcessVersionInfoProductName),
    ExampleCompany =
        take_any(ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName),
    ExamplePath =
        take_any(FolderPath),
    ExampleSHA256 =
        take_any(SHA256)
  by
    ToolKey
| extend
    IsSanctioned =
        array_length(SelectedAgentKeys) > 0
        and set_has_element(SelectedAgentKeys, tolower(ToolKey))
| extend
    Governance =
        iff(
            IsSanctioned,
            "🟢 Sanctioned",
            "🔴 Unsanctioned"
        ),
    Risk =
        case(
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "High",
                "🔴 High",
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "Medium",
                "🟠 Medium",
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "Low",
                "🟡 Low",
            strcat("⚪ ", tostring(ToolRiskLevel))
        ),
    RiskOrder =
        case(
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "High",
                1,
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "Medium",
                2,
            ToolRiskLevel =~ "Low",
                3,
            4
        )

// ============================================================
// CLOUD AI AGENT / TOOL DETECTION
// ============================================================
// Reads cloud rows from ai_agent_watchlist.csv.
// Missing source tables are ignored with union isfuzzy=true.
// Produces one row per normalized cloud agent.
// ============================================================
// ============================================================
// WATCHLIST
// ============================================================
let AgentWatchlist =
    externaldata(
        Name:string,
        Category:string,
        MatchField:string,
        Pattern:string,
        MatchType:string,
        RiskLevel:string,
        DefaultAction:string,
        Reason:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        Vendor:string,
        SourceFrom:string,
        TelemetrySource:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_agent_watchlist.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )
    | extend
        SourceFrom =
            trim(
                @"[\s]+",
                tostring(SourceFrom)
            ),
        AgentKey =
            replace_regex(
                tolower(tostring(Name)),
                "[^a-z0-9]",
                ""
            ),
        SearchPattern =
            tolower(
                case(
                    MatchType =~ "Wildcard",
                        replace_string(
                            replace_string(Pattern, "*", ""),
                            "?",
                            ""
                        ),
                    Pattern
                )
            )
    | where tolower(SourceFrom) == "cloud"
    | where isnotempty(AgentKey)
    | where isnotempty(SearchPattern)
    | distinct
        Name,
        Category,
        MatchField,
        Pattern,
        MatchType,
        RiskLevel,
        DefaultAction,
        Reason,
        SourceURL,
        Vendor,
        SourceFrom,
        TelemetrySource,
        AgentKey,
        SearchPattern;
// ============================================================
// SANCTIONED AI AGENT POLICY KEYS
// ============================================================
let SanctionedAgents =
    dynamic([{SanctionedAgents}]);

let SelectedAgentKeys =
    toscalar(
        print SelectedValue = SanctionedAgents
        | mv-expand SelectedValue
        | extend SelectedKey =
            replace_regex(
                tolower(tostring(SelectedValue)),
                "[^a-z0-9]",
                ""
            )
        | where isnotempty(SelectedKey)
        | summarize make_set(SelectedKey, 500)
    );

// ============================================================
// OPTIONAL CLOUD TABLES
// ============================================================
let CloudEvents =
    union isfuzzy=true
    (
        // Microsoft 365 and Purview audit activity
        OfficeActivity
        | where TimeGenerated between (
            {TimeRange:start}
            ..
            {TimeRange:end}
        )
        | extend
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RecordId = tostring(OfficeId),
            Actor = tostring(coalesce(UserId, Actor, Application)),
            ActorIP = tostring(coalesce(ClientIP, ActorIpAddress, Client_IPAddress)),
            OperationText = tostring(coalesce(Operation, Activity)),
            ResourceText = tostring(coalesce(Application, OfficeWorkload, OfficeObjectId, ItemName, TeamName, ChatName)),
            SearchText =
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        UserId,
                        " ",
                        Actor,
                        " ",
                        Application,
                        " ",
                        Operation,
                        " ",
                        Activity,
                        " ",
                        OfficeWorkload,
                        " ",
                        AddonName,
                        " ",
                        CustomEvent,
                        " ",
                        Parameters,
                        " ",
                        ModifiedProperties,
                        " ",
                        OfficeObjectId,
                        " ",
                        ItemName,
                        " ",
                        TeamName,
                        " ",
                        ChatName,
                        " ",
                        ChannelName
                    )
                ),
            Evidence =
                strcat(
                    "Operation=",
                    Operation,
                    "; Activity=",
                    Activity,
                    "; Application=",
                    Application,
                    "; OfficeWorkload=",
                    OfficeWorkload,
                    "; Item=",
                    ItemName,
                    "; Resource=",
                    OfficeObjectId,
                    "; Parameters=",
                    Parameters
                )
        | project
            ObservedTable = "OfficeActivity",
            EventTime,
            RecordId,
            Actor,
            ActorIP,
            OperationText,
            ResourceText,
            SearchText,
            Evidence
    ),
    (
        // Microsoft Entra audit activity
        AuditLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (
            {TimeRange:start}
            ..
            {TimeRange:end}
        )
        | extend
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RecordId = tostring(Id),
            Actor = tostring(coalesce(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName, InitiatedBy.app.displayName, Identity)),
            ActorIP = "",
            OperationText = tostring(coalesce(ActivityDisplayName, OperationName)),
            ResourceText = tostring(ResourceId),
            SearchText =
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        ActivityDisplayName,
                        " ",
                        OperationName,
                        " ",
                        Identity,
                        " ",
                        tostring(InitiatedBy),
                        " ",
                        tostring(TargetResources),
                        " ",
                        tostring(AdditionalDetails),
                        " ",
                        LoggedByService,
                        " ",
                        ResourceProvider,
                        " ",
                        ResourceId,
                        " ",
                        ResultDescription
                    )
                ),
            Evidence =
                strcat(
                    "Activity=",
                    ActivityDisplayName,
                    "; Operation=",
                    OperationName,
                    "; Identity=",
                    Identity,
                    "; InitiatedBy=",
                    tostring(InitiatedBy),
                    "; TargetResources=",
                    tostring(TargetResources),
                    "; Result=",
                    ResultType,
                    "; Description=",
                    ResultDescription
                )
        | project
            ObservedTable = "AuditLogs",
            EventTime,
            RecordId,
            Actor,
            ActorIP,
            OperationText,
            ResourceText,
            SearchText,
            Evidence
    ),
    (
        // Microsoft Entra service-principal sign-ins
        AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
        | where TimeGenerated between (
            {TimeRange:start}
            ..
            {TimeRange:end}
        )
        | extend
            EventTime = TimeGenerated,
            RecordId = tostring(Id),
            Actor = tostring(coalesce(ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId, AppId, Identity)),
            ActorIP = tostring(IPAddress),
            OperationText = tostring(OperationName),
            ResourceText = tostring(coalesce(ResourceDisplayName, ResourceIdentity, ResourceServicePrincipalId)),
            SearchText =
                tolower(
                    strcat(
                        ServicePrincipalName,
                        " ",
                        ServicePrincipalId,
                        " ",
                        AppId,
                        " ",
                        Identity,
                        " ",
                        ResourceDisplayName,
                        " ",
                        ResourceIdentity,
                        " ",
                        Agent,
                        " ",
                        OperationName,
                        " ",
                        ResultType,
                        " ",
                        ResultDescription,
                        " ",
                        UserAgent
                    )
                ),
            Evidence =
                strcat(
                    "ServicePrincipal=",
                    ServicePrincipalName,
                    "; ServicePrincipalId=",
                    ServicePrincipalId,
                    "; AppId=",
                    AppId,
                    "; Resource=",
                    ResourceDisplayName,
                    "; Result=",
                    ResultType,
                    "; Description=",
                    ResultDescription,
                    "; UserAgent=",
                    UserAgent
                )
        | project
            ObservedTable = "AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs",
            EventTime,
            RecordId,
            Actor,
            ActorIP,
            OperationText,
            ResourceText,
            SearchText,
            Evidence
    );
// ============================================================
// BUILD CLOUD SEARCH LIST
// ============================================================
let CloudPatterns =
    toscalar(
        AgentWatchlist
        | summarize make_set(SearchPattern, 500)
    );
// ============================================================
// CANDIDATE CLOUD EVENTS
// ============================================================
let CandidateCloudEvents =
    CloudEvents
    | where EventTime between (
        {TimeRange:start}
        ..
        {TimeRange:end}
    )
    | where isnotempty(SearchText)
    | where SearchText has_any(CloudPatterns)
    | extend
        EventKey =
            strcat(
                ObservedTable,
                "|",
                RecordId,
                "|",
                tostring(EventTime),
                "|",
                Actor,
                "|",
                OperationText
            );
// ============================================================
// MATCH CLOUD WATCHLIST
// ============================================================
let CloudMatches =
    CandidateCloudEvents
    | extend JoinKey = 1
    | join kind=inner (
        AgentWatchlist
        | extend JoinKey = 1
    ) on JoinKey
    | where SearchText contains SearchPattern
    | summarize
        arg_max(EventTime, *)
      by
        EventKey,
        AgentKey,
        Vendor,
        Pattern,
        SourceFrom;
// ============================================================
// SUMMARISE BY NORMALIZED CLOUD AGENT
// ============================================================
CloudMatches
| summarize
    AgentName = take_any(Name),
    AgentVendor = take_any(Vendor),
    AgentCategory = take_any(Category),
    AgentFrom = take_any(SourceFrom),
    AgentTelemetrySource = take_any(TelemetrySource),
    AgentRiskLevel = take_any(RiskLevel),
    AgentDefaultAction = take_any(DefaultAction),
    AgentReason = take_any(Reason),
    FirstSeen = min(EventTime),
    LastSeen = max(EventTime),
    Events = dcount(EventKey),
    Users = dcount(Actor),
    TableCount = dcount(ObservedTable),
    UserList = make_set_if(Actor, isnotempty(Actor), 30),
    IPList = make_set_if(ActorIP, isnotempty(ActorIP), 30),
    ObservedTableList = make_set(ObservedTable, 20),
    Operations = make_set(OperationText, 30),
    Resources = make_set(ResourceText, 30),
    Patterns = make_set(Pattern, 50),
    Sources = make_set(SourceURL, 10),
    ExampleActor = take_any(Actor),
    ExampleOperation = take_any(OperationText),
    ExampleResource = take_any(ResourceText),
    ExampleEvidence = take_any(Evidence)
  by
    AgentKey
// ============================================================
// DISPLAY RISK AND OUTPUT
// ============================================================
| extend
    IsSanctioned =
        array_length(SelectedAgentKeys) > 0
        and set_has_element(SelectedAgentKeys, tolower(AgentKey))
| extend
    Governance =
        iff(
            IsSanctioned,
            "🟢 Sanctioned",
            "🔴 Unsanctioned"
        ),
    Risk =
        case(
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "High",
                "🔴 High",
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "Medium",
                "🟠 Medium",
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "Low",
                "🟡 Low",
            strcat("⚪ ", tostring(AgentRiskLevel))
        ),
    RiskOrder =
        case(
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "High",
                1,
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "Medium",
                2,
            AgentRiskLevel =~ "Low",
                3,
            4
        ),
    ObservedTables =
        strcat_array(
            ObservedTableList,
            ", "
        ),
    PatternList =
        strcat_array(
            Patterns,
            ", "
        )
| project
    Tool = AgentName,
    Vendor = AgentVendor,
    ['From'] = AgentFrom,
    ['Telemetry Source'] = AgentTelemetrySource,
    ['Observed Tables'] = ObservedTables,
    ['Policy Mapping'] =
        iff(
            IsSanctioned,
            "Sanctioned",
            "Unsanctioned"
        ),
    Governance,
    Risk,
    Category = AgentCategory,
    Users,
    Tables = TableCount,
    ['User List'] = UserList,
    ['IP List'] = IPList,
    Operations,
    Resources,
    Pattern = PatternList,
    Sources,
    Actor = ExampleActor,
    Operation = ExampleOperation,
    Resource = ExampleResource,
    Events,
    ['First Seen'] = FirstSeen,
    ['Last Seen'] = LastSeen,
    DefaultAction = AgentDefaultAction,
    Reason = AgentReason,
    Evidence = ExampleEvidence,
    RiskOrder
| order by
    RiskOrder asc,
    Users desc,
    Events desc,
    ['Last Seen'] desc
| project-away RiskOrder

## 🤖 Understanding the AI Agent Detection Results

These reports compare observed activity against the maintained AI agent detection catalogue and the selected sanctioned-agent policy.

The **Local** report uses endpoint process telemetry to identify local agents, model hosts, and agent tooling through process names and command lines. The **Cloud** report uses available audit and identity telemetry, including Microsoft 365, Entra, Purview, Defender, and service-principal activity.

Results are grouped into one row per detected agent. Each row includes the affected users, devices or tables, observed operations, evidence, first and last seen times, risk level, and recommended default action.

Risk and action values come from the detection catalogue and support investigation. They do not determine whether an agent is sanctioned or unsanctioned; that classification comes from the selected sanctioned-agent policies.

### Catalogue and Governance Watchlist

The public `ai_agent_watchlist.csv` catalogue is used to match local and cloud AI agents and tools.

The optional local governance file `ai_agent_governance_watchlist.csv` is uploaded to Sentinel as the **AIAgentGovernance** watchlist. It contains customer-specific governance entries and sanctioned selections, using the `Key` column as the Sentinel SearchKey. It does not replace the public detection catalogue.

### Log Sources

- **DeviceProcessEvents** — Local agent, model-host, process-name, and command-line activity.
- **OfficeActivity** — Microsoft 365 and Purview audit activity.
- **AuditLogs** — Microsoft Entra audit activity.
- **AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs** — Microsoft Entra service-principal sign-in activity.

Cloud sources are queried opportunistically; unavailable tables are ignored.

## 🔎 AI Deep Search

These reports use a broader consolidated AI and agent watchlist to identify products not already covered by the standard public or local sources.

The device report searches `DeviceNetworkEvents` and `DeviceProcessEvents`. The agent report searches available agent and AI service telemetry.

Results are intended for enrichment and investigation. `AlreadyCovered = false` highlights additional watchlist items outside the existing reports.

If you need to cover these products or agents in the standard reports, please add them to your local Watchlists.
