let Watchlist =
    externaldata(
        SearchKey:string,
        Provider:string,
        Product:string,
        ProductAliases:string,
        IndicatorType:string,
        IndicatorValue:string,
        MatchRule:string,
        MatchField:string,
        Category:string,
        RiskType:string,
        MatchConfidence:string,
        Active:string,
        Sanctioned:string,
        ReportableByDefault:string,
        SourceURL:string,
        SourceLists:string,
        TelemetrySource:string,
        Notes:string
    )
    [
        @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/refs/heads/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_consolidated_sentinel_watchlist.csv"
    ]
    with (
        format="csv",
        ignoreFirstRecord=true
    )
    | where Active =~ "true"
    | where IndicatorType in (
        "domain",
        "process_name",
        "product_name",
        "publisher",
        "process_commandline"
    )
    | extend WatchlistKeyRaw = tolower(trim(@"[ \t]+", SearchKey))
    | extend WatchlistKey =
        case(
            IndicatorType == "domain"
                and MatchRule in ("exact", "exact_host", "registered_domain"),
                replace_regex(
                    replace_regex(
                        replace_regex(
                            WatchlistKeyRaw,
                            @"^https?://",
                            ""
                        ),
                        @"/.*$",
                        ""
                    ),
                    @"^www\.",
                    ""
                ),
            IndicatorType == "domain",
                replace_regex(
                    replace_regex(
                        WatchlistKeyRaw,
                        @"^https?://",
                        ""
                    ),
                    @"^www\.",
                    ""
                ),
            WatchlistKeyRaw
        )
    | extend
        InExpandedDomains = SourceLists contains "ai_domains_expanded",
        InAgentList = SourceLists contains "ai_agent_watchlist"
    | extend
        AlreadyCovered = InExpandedDomains or InAgentList,
        SourceListGroup = replace_string(SourceLists, " | ", " + ")
    | where AlreadyCovered == false
    | where
        MatchRule == "exact"
        or MatchRule == "exact_host"
        or MatchRule == "registered_domain"
        or MatchRule == "contains"
        or MatchRule == "wildcard"
        or MatchRule == "url_prefix"
    | extend JoinKey = strcat(IndicatorType, "|", WatchlistKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        WatchlistKey,
        Provider,
        Product,
        ProductAliases,
        IndicatorType,
        IndicatorValue,
        MatchRule,
        MatchField,
        Category,
        RiskType,
        MatchConfidence,
        Sanctioned,
        ReportableByDefault,
        SourceURL,
        SourceLists,
        SourceListGroup,
        TelemetrySource,
        Notes,
        AlreadyCovered;

let NetworkObserved =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | extend
        UrlPathKey = replace_regex(
            tolower(trim(@"[ \t]+", tostring(RemoteUrl))),
            @"^https?://",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        DomainKeyRaw = tostring(
            extract(
                @"^(?:https?://)?([^/:?#]+)",
                1,
                tostring(RemoteUrl)
            )
        )
    | extend
        DomainKey = replace_regex(
            tolower(trim(@"[ \t]+", DomainKeyRaw)),
            @"^www\.",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        DomainRoot2 = tostring(
            extract(@"([^.]+\.[^.]+)$", 1, DomainKey)
        ),
        DomainRoot3 = tostring(
            extract(@"([^.]+\.[^.]+\.[^.]+)$", 1, DomainKey)
        )
    | where isnotempty(DomainKey)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("domain|", DomainKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceNetworkEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        UrlKey = tostring(RemoteUrl),
        UrlPathKey,
        EvidenceText = tostring(RemoteUrl);

let NetworkRegisteredRoot2Observed =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | extend
        DomainKeyRaw = tostring(
            extract(
                @"^(?:https?://)?([^/:?#]+)",
                1,
                tostring(RemoteUrl)
            )
        )
    | extend
        DomainKey = replace_regex(
            tolower(trim(@"[ \t]+", DomainKeyRaw)),
            @"^www\.",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        DomainRoot2 = tostring(
            extract(@"([^.]+\.[^.]+)$", 1, DomainKey)
        )
    | where isnotempty(DomainRoot2)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("domain|", DomainRoot2)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceNetworkEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = tostring(RemoteUrl);

let NetworkRegisteredRoot3Observed =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | extend
        DomainKeyRaw = tostring(
            extract(
                @"^(?:https?://)?([^/:?#]+)",
                1,
                tostring(RemoteUrl)
            )
        )
    | extend
        DomainKey = replace_regex(
            tolower(trim(@"[ \t]+", DomainKeyRaw)),
            @"^www\.",
            ""
        )
    | extend
        DomainRoot3 = tostring(
            extract(@"([^.]+\.[^.]+\.[^.]+)$", 1, DomainKey)
        )
    | where isnotempty(DomainRoot3)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("domain|", DomainRoot3)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceNetworkEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = tostring(RemoteUrl);

let ProcessEvents =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
    | extend
        ProcessNameKey = tolower(
            trim(@"[ \t]+", tostring(FileName))
        ),
        ProductNameKey = tolower(
            trim(
                @"[ \t]+",
                tostring(
                    column_ifexists(
                        "ProcessVersionInfoProductName",
                        ""
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        PublisherKey = tolower(
            trim(
                @"[ \t]+",
                tostring(
                    column_ifexists(
                        "ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName",
                        ""
                    )
                )
            )
        ),
        CommandLineKey = tolower(
            trim(
                @"[ \t]+",
                tostring(
                    column_ifexists(
                        "ProcessCommandLine",
                        ""
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    | project
        Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        ProcessNameKey,
        ProductNameKey,
        PublisherKey,
        CommandLineKey;

let ProcessNameObserved =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(ProcessNameKey)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("process_name|", ProcessNameKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = ProcessNameKey;

let ProductNameObserved =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(ProductNameKey)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("product_name|", ProductNameKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = ProductNameKey;

let PublisherObserved =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(PublisherKey)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("publisher|", PublisherKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = PublisherKey;

let CommandLineObserved =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(CommandLineKey)
    | extend JoinKey = strcat("process_commandline|", CommandLineKey)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = CommandLineKey;

let CommandLinePatternLookup =
    Watchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "process_commandline"
    | where MatchRule == "contains"
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let CommandLinePatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        CommandLinePatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let CommandLinePatternCandidates =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(CommandLineKey)
    | where CommandLineKey has_any (CommandLinePatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "process_commandline";

let CommandLinePatternMatches =
    CommandLinePatternCandidates
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (CommandLinePatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where CommandLineKey contains PatternKey
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = CommandLineKey;

let ProcessNamePatternLookup =
    Watchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "process_name"
    | where MatchRule == "wildcard"
    | extend
        IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType,
        PatternPrefix = replace_string(WatchlistKey, "*", "")
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        PatternPrefix,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let ProcessNamePatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        ProcessNamePatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternPrefix)
    );

let ProcessNamePatternCandidates =
    ProcessEvents
    | where isnotempty(ProcessNameKey)
    | where ProcessNameKey has_any (ProcessNamePatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "process_name";

let ProcessNamePatternMatches =
    ProcessNamePatternCandidates
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (ProcessNamePatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where ProcessNameKey startswith PatternPrefix
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        ObservedTable = "DeviceProcessEvents",
        EventTime = Timestamp,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText = ProcessNameKey;

let DomainPrefixLookup =
    Watchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "domain"
    | where MatchRule == "url_prefix"
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let DomainPrefixTokens =
    toscalar(
        DomainPrefixLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let DomainPrefixCandidates =
    NetworkObserved
    | where isnotempty(UrlPathKey)
    | where UrlPathKey has_any (DomainPrefixTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "domain";

let DomainPrefixMatches =
    DomainPrefixCandidates
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (DomainPrefixLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where UrlPathKey startswith PatternKey
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        ObservedTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let Observed =
    union
        NetworkObserved,
        NetworkRegisteredRoot2Observed,
        NetworkRegisteredRoot3Observed,
        ProcessNameObserved,
        ProductNameObserved,
        PublisherObserved,
        CommandLineObserved;

let ObservedMatches =
    Observed
    | join kind=inner (Watchlist) on JoinKey
    | project
        JoinKey,
        Provider,
        Product,
        IndicatorType,
        MatchRule,
        ObservedTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AllObservedMatches =
    union
        ObservedMatches,
        CommandLinePatternMatches,
        ProcessNamePatternMatches,
        DomainPrefixMatches;

let MatchedByKey =
    AllObservedMatches
    | summarize
        MatchedEvents = count(),

let AgentWatchlist =
    materialize(
        externaldata(
            SearchKey:string,
            Provider:string,
            Product:string,
            ProductAliases:string,
            IndicatorType:string,
            IndicatorValue:string,
            MatchRule:string,
            MatchField:string,
            Category:string,
            RiskType:string,
            MatchConfidence:string,
            Active:string,
            Sanctioned:string,
            ReportableByDefault:string,
            SourceURL:string,
            SourceLists:string,
            TelemetrySource:string,
            Notes:string
        )
        [
            @"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/refs/heads/master/Sample%20Data/AIGovernance/ai_consolidated_sentinel_watchlist.csv"
        ]
        with (
            format="csv",
            ignoreFirstRecord=true
        )
        | where Active =~ "true"
        | where IndicatorType in (
            "agent_name",
            "agent_id",
            "service_api",
            "agent_registry"
        )
        | extend
            WatchlistKey = tolower(
                trim(@"[ \t]+", SearchKey)
            ),
            InExpandedDomains = SourceLists contains "ai_domains_expanded",
            InAgentList = SourceLists contains "ai_agent_watchlist"
        | extend
            AlreadyCovered = InExpandedDomains or InAgentList,
            SourceListGroup = replace_string(SourceLists, " | ", " + ")
        | extend JoinKey = strcat(IndicatorType, "|", WatchlistKey)
        | project
            JoinKey,
            WatchlistKey,
            Provider,
            Product,
            ProductAliases,
            IndicatorType,
            IndicatorValue,
            MatchRule,
            MatchField,
            Category,
            RiskType,
            MatchConfidence,
            Sanctioned,
            ReportableByDefault,
            SourceURL,
            SourceLists,
            SourceListGroup,
            TelemetrySource,
            Notes,
            AlreadyCovered
    );

let AgentEvidence =
    materialize(
        union withsource=AgentTable isfuzzy=true
            RiskyAgents,
            AgentRiskEvents,
            NetworkAccessGenerativeAIInsights,
            NetworkAccessTrafficLogs,
            NetworkAccessAlerts,
            NetworkAccessConnectionEvents
        | extend
            EventTime = coalesce(
                todatetime(column_ifexists("Timestamp", datetime(null))),
                todatetime(column_ifexists("TimeGenerated", datetime(null)))
            ),
            DeviceName = tostring(
                coalesce(
                    column_ifexists("DeviceName", ""),
                    column_ifexists("Computer", "")
                )
            ),
            AgentName = tolower(
                trim(
                    @"[ \t]+",
                    tostring(
                        coalesce(
                            column_ifexists("AgentName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("AgentDisplayName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("AppName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ApplicationName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ProductName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("Name", "")
                        )
                    )
                )
            ),
            AgentId = tolower(
                trim(
                    @"[ \t]+",
                    tostring(
                        coalesce(
                            column_ifexists("AgentId", ""),
                            column_ifexists("AgentID", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ApplicationId", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ApplicationID", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ObjectId", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ServicePrincipalId", "")
                        )
                    )
                )
            ),
            ServiceApi = tolower(
                trim(
                    @"[ \t]+",
                    tostring(
                        coalesce(
                            column_ifexists("ServiceApi", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ServiceAPI", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ServiceName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ApiName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("Provider", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ResourceName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("CloudAppName", "")
                        )
                    )
                )
            ),
            AgentRegistry = tolower(
                trim(
                    @"[ \t]+",
                    tostring(
                        coalesce(
                            column_ifexists("AgentRegistry", ""),
                            column_ifexists("RegistryKey", ""),
                            column_ifexists("RegistryPath", ""),
                            column_ifexists("RegistryName", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ResourceId", ""),
                            column_ifexists("ResourceID", "")
                        )
                    )
                )
            ),
            EvidenceText = tostring(pack_all())
        | where EventTime between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
        | project
            AgentTable,
            EventTime,
            DeviceName,
            AgentName,
            AgentId,
            ServiceApi,
            AgentRegistry,
            EvidenceText
    );

let AgentNameObserved =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentName)
    | extend
        IndicatorType = "agent_name",
        JoinKey = strcat("agent_name|", AgentName)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentIdObserved =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentId)
    | extend
        IndicatorType = "agent_id",
        JoinKey = strcat("agent_id|", AgentId)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let ServiceApiObserved =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(ServiceApi)
    | extend
        IndicatorType = "service_api",
        JoinKey = strcat("service_api|", ServiceApi)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentRegistryObserved =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentRegistry)
    | extend
        IndicatorType = "agent_registry",
        JoinKey = strcat("agent_registry|", AgentRegistry)
    | project
        JoinKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentObserved =
    union
        AgentNameObserved,
        AgentIdObserved,
        ServiceApiObserved,
        AgentRegistryObserved;

let AgentExactMatches =
    AgentObserved
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (
        AgentWatchlist
        | where MatchRule == "exact"
        | project
            JoinKey,
            Provider,
            Product,
            IndicatorType,
            MatchRule
    ) on JoinKey
    | project
        JoinKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentNamePatternLookup =
    AgentWatchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "agent_name"
    | where MatchRule in ("contains", "prefix")
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        MatchRule,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let AgentIdPatternLookup =
    AgentWatchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "agent_id"
    | where MatchRule in ("contains", "prefix")
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        MatchRule,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let ServiceApiPatternLookup =
    AgentWatchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "service_api"
    | where MatchRule in ("contains", "prefix")
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        MatchRule,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let AgentRegistryPatternLookup =
    AgentWatchlist
    | where IndicatorType == "agent_registry"
    | where MatchRule in ("contains", "prefix")
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = IndicatorType
    | project
        PatternKey = WatchlistKey,
        MatchKey = JoinKey,
        MatchRule,
        IndicatorTypeKey;

let AgentNamePatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        AgentNamePatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let AgentIdPatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        AgentIdPatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let ServiceApiPatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        ServiceApiPatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let AgentRegistryPatternTokens =
    toscalar(
        AgentRegistryPatternLookup
        | summarize make_set(PatternKey)
    );

let AgentNamePatternMatches =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentName)
    | where AgentName has_any (AgentNamePatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "agent_name"
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (AgentNamePatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where
        (
            MatchRule == "contains"
            and AgentName contains PatternKey
        )
        or
        (
            MatchRule == "prefix"
            and AgentName startswith PatternKey
        )
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentIdPatternMatches =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentId)
    | where AgentId has_any (AgentIdPatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "agent_id"
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (AgentIdPatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where
        (
            MatchRule == "contains"
            and AgentId contains PatternKey
        )
        or
        (
            MatchRule == "prefix"
            and AgentId startswith PatternKey
        )
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let ServiceApiPatternMatches =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(ServiceApi)
    | where ServiceApi has_any (ServiceApiPatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "service_api"
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (ServiceApiPatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where
        (
            MatchRule == "contains"
            and ServiceApi contains PatternKey
        )
        or
        (
            MatchRule == "prefix"
            and ServiceApi startswith PatternKey
        )
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AgentRegistryPatternMatches =
    AgentEvidence
    | where isnotempty(AgentRegistry)
    | where AgentRegistry has_any (AgentRegistryPatternTokens)
    | extend IndicatorTypeKey = "agent_registry"
    | join kind=inner hint.strategy=broadcast (AgentRegistryPatternLookup)
        on IndicatorTypeKey
    | where
        (
            MatchRule == "contains"
            and AgentRegistry contains PatternKey
        )
        or
        (
            MatchRule == "prefix"
            and AgentRegistry startswith PatternKey
        )
    | project
        JoinKey = MatchKey,
        AgentTable,
        EventTime,
        DeviceName,
        EvidenceText;

let AllAgentMatches =
    union
        AgentExactMatches,
        AgentNamePatternMatches,
        AgentIdPatternMatches,
        ServiceApiPatternMatches,
        AgentRegistryPatternMatches;

let MatchedByKey =
    AllAgentMatches
    | summarize
        MatchedEvents = count(),
        FirstSeen = min(EventTime),
        LastSeen = max(EventTime),
        Devices = make_set(DeviceName, 100),
        Evidence = make_set(EvidenceText, 100),
        MatchedTables = make_set(AgentTable, 20)
        by JoinKey;

AgentWatchlist
| join kind=leftouter (MatchedByKey) on JoinKey
| extend
    MatchedEvents = coalesce(MatchedEvents, 0),
    MatchStatus = iff(
        MatchedEvents > 0,
        "Observed",
        "Not observed"
    )
| project
    Provider,
    Product,
    ProductAliases,
    IndicatorType,
    IndicatorValue,
    MatchRule,
    Category,
    RiskType,
    MatchConfidence,
    SourceListGroup,
    SourceLists,
    AlreadyCovered,
    MatchStatus,
    MatchedEvents,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    Devices,
    Evidence,
    MatchedTables,
    SourceURL,
    TelemetrySource,
    Notes
| order by
    MatchedEvents desc,
    Provider asc,
    Product asc

## 🤖 AI Agents and Tools

These reports use the AI agent and tool watchlist to identify local agents, cloud agents, local model hosts and agentic tooling.

The local agent report searches `DeviceProcessEvents`. Cloud agent detection uses available audit and identity telemetry, including `OfficeActivity`, `AuditLogs` and service-principal sign-in data where available.

Optional customer-specific agents can be added through the `AIAgentGovernance` Watchlist. Selected entries marked `Sanctioned=TRUE` are included automatically in the governance view.

Results are intended to support agent inventory, governance review and investigation.

If an agent or tool is not recognised, please add it to the local `AIAgentGovernance` Watchlist.

# 📊 AI Governance Summary

This summary shows the breadth of the AI governance capability covered by the workbook.

The tiles count the catalogue entries used by the workbook across three areas:

- **AI Services** — recognised AI providers and products, including web services, APIs, developer tools and desktop clients.
- **AI Agents and Tools** — recognised local and cloud AI agents, model hosts and agentic tooling.
- **AI Deep Search** — additional providers and products searched across network, process, publisher and command-line telemetry.

These figures represent the number of providers and products available in the detection catalogues. They do not represent observed usage during the selected time range.

The detailed workbook tabs use these catalogues to identify activity, classify sanctioned and unsanctioned usage, and provide supporting evidence from Microsoft Defender telemetry.
